Please can you lock in our London hotel for the AI Summit? We need the property whose guest reviews explicitly mention views of the River Thames, for a stay from 28 to 30 May. From what I remember, the one that stands out for those river-view mentions is Riverside View.

Could you search London hotels, check the reviews, and reserve that one now?

Thank you,
Mark
